title: intent-cli's last hand-made label grammar and ordinal ids
objective: intent-cli reads a criterion or test label, and makes an ordinal id, only through `intentsvcs::id`.
body:
## Rows

B1 and Report E's D9, the intent-cli half (triage P13). B8 and Report E's T8, the TUI half (triage P26). Checked by ic at bd1aa3c6c.

## Deliverables

- The unit test `no_tracker_id_reaches_a_published_tool` (`intent-cli/src/mcp.rs`, from line 2556) reads a label with `intentsvcs::id::label_at` and keeps only its own extras.
- The long-list fixture in `intent-cli/src/tui/app.rs:2470, 2472` makes its ids with `ThreadId::from_ordinal`.
- The stray doc line at `intent-cli/src/render.rs:9966`, which has been joined to `gate_verdict`'s doc since 2026-08-15 and names `ST0000/03`, is removed. Found by ic in Phase 0.

## Approach

Replace the hand grammar and the hand format. Keep each test's subject.

## Dependencies

The label reader (cc, ST1c2db93/e92b). This package lands in the same bank as it, or after it.

## Risks

The scanner now reads a label whose group is a git-style package, so it can find a label in published text that it missed before. Such a red is a finding to fix, not to silence.

## Verification

Before the bank, the builder runs clippy and critic-rust on its diff.

The batch decides this package: one `bin/devbin gate all` and one `bin/devbin test shell` at main's HEAD, after the last bank lands, booked by vc with the Desk. No gate and no suite runs for this bank alone.

## Seat and size

ic (intent-cli). XS.
